evidence_classes.structural_artifact: header magic, LE n_gate/n_wires/n_in/n_out/depth, <BQQQ> stride 25, SHA-256, construction-count receipts, git files on a named SHA
evidence_classes.demonstrated_runtime: host walk/evaluate of an organ producing next-state bits. Public excerpts say structural-only / never evaluated; this host did not walk them
evidence_classes.customer_demand: a named buyer who paid or posted non-confidential interest. Status on this SHA: UNKNOWN. commercial.json status PROPOSED. payment_ready collectable_usd NOT_LANDED

paths.painful_job: Need a citable, hash-pinned inventory of what SUBZERO actually is, not a Slack essay or a bake.
paths.why_subzero: 31 public excerpts plus construction receipts already exist. This run remeasured 6 organs on SHA 009f52db; GRBN matches PR 2131 (228638 B, 8704 gates).
paths.offer: catalog/receipt: SHA-pinned excerpt table + card + DIO-style receipt pointers. Not a GGUF edit. Not the computer.
paths.proof_missing: a buyer who will pay for a catalog that is already public
paths.falsifier: buyer requires runtime traces or GGUF ablation; or packet includes titan/foundry
paths.channel: OFFER inbox / commercial.html adjacent public form; no outreach this run
paths.time_to_first_invoice: offer-ready NOW; collectible only after owner payout dest + one buyer

paths.painful_job: Need a bounded packet proving a self-clocked random Boolean network is a real netlist, not a metaphor, before booking FPGA time.
paths.why_subzero: GRBN: N=256 K=3, 8704 gates, depth 7, self-clock state-out=state-in. PR 2131 measured the same file. Siemens 2024 FPGA study: 87% of projects reported non-trivial bug escapes — buyers already pay for pre-lab certainty.
paths.offer: feasibility packet: header decode, construction count, gate/wire/depth, SHA, what a walk would mean. No FPGA bitstream. No White Box GGUF work.
acceptance: customer can re-hash the public file
paths.proof_missing: any customer FPGA pinout or clock-domain constraint; runtime settle trace
paths.falsifier: packet claims the organ was walked; or sells a bitstream; or collides with $30k White Box
paths.channel: public non-confidential interest to OFFER; FPGA vendor forums later, no outreach now
paths.time_to_first_invoice: 10d after payout dest + one edge team

paths.painful_job: Need a byte-exact checker for an unfamiliar 25-byte gate format before they will treat the files as computers.
paths.why_subzero: PR 2131 landed revenue/dio/substrate_receipt.py: header, gate, wire, artifact, SHA-256. Synopsys FY2025 Design Automation $5.302B and Cadence FY2025 $5.297B show the buyer class already buys verification tools.
paths.offer: test harness / support SKU: run substrate_receipt check on a named excerpt, deliver the JSON receipt. License is use of the public checker plus a written finding. Not EDA seat replacement.
acceptance: check exits 0 on the named file
payment reference does not prove delivery
paths.proof_missing: vendor willingness to pay for a stdlib checker they could run free
paths.falsifier: harness claims PAID without receipt; or adds login; or checks a GGUF as if it were SUBZERO
paths.channel: bazaar later USD offer after payout dest; tools stay free to run

paths.painful_job: Need a lab that teaches self-clocked gate organs without transferring a factory or booking the founder.
paths.why_subzero: NSF CISE FY2025 request $1.06758B; Future CoRe typical $150k-$250k/yr. Public excerpts + fab --dry scripts are already the lab kit. Portfolio says live founder briefings collide with White Box NOW.
paths.offer: training kit: recorded/workbook materials over public excerpts. No hide-list. No titan offsets. No founder day unless White Box slot is empty.
paths.gross_margin_hypothesis: 0.75-0.88 on materials; live founder day deferred
paths.proof_missing: a course owner who will pay for public files packaged as a kit
paths.falsifier: kit includes foundry genes or titan MOVE instructions as product
paths.channel: university shop / OFFER; no student PII on public roads

paths.painful_job: Need a priced miss that distinguishes structural proof from a walked organ, so they stop treating silence as inert.
paths.why_subzero: Receipts already say the battery is structural only and copies do not run. Owner law: a zero must carry search space. This is the failure-packets lane, not White Box.
paths.offer: failure packet: named search (walk vs header), FINDER-FAILED if no runtime, never a silent 0.
inputs: stated walk command that this host will not invent as success
paths.proof_missing: buyer who pays for a documented miss
paths.falsifier: packet reports 0 with no search space; or claims a walk that was not run
paths.channel: public receipts now; priced SKU after payout dest
paths.time_to_first_invoice: NOW offer-ready; invoice after payout dest

paths.painful_job: Need to know whether a 8704-gate self-clocked RBN can be placed on an adaptive SoC without a host scheduler.
paths.why_subzero: GRBN construction is exact. AMD FY2025 Embedded $3.454B plus Data Center FPGA/adaptive SoC in the $16.635B segment show the hardware class exists. Mapping is not yet demonstrated.
paths.offer: paid prototype: one GRBN-to-HDL structural translation + synthesis report on a customer-named part. No factory transfer. No GGUF.
paths.proof_missing: any bitstream, any on-chip settle, any customer part number
paths.falsifier: synthesis fails; or prototype sold as qualified silicon; or defense-ready claim
paths.channel: after P02; private SOW; no outreach now

paths.painful_job: Need a negative-selection anomaly bit they can hash, not another ML detector they cannot replay.
paths.why_subzero: IMMN: 128 detectors, 32-bit window, 29951 gates, alarm-bit result plane, flags-never-gates. NIST publishes assured-autonomy research (Kuhn et al. 2024) but this is not a NIST-certified product.
paths.offer: paid prototype: map one public window onto the detector plane and report the alarm bit with hashes. Not a security product. Not CUI/ITAR work.
acceptance: alarm bit is 0 or 1 with hash
paths.proof_missing: a walk that actually produces the alarm bit; any ROC/false-positive data
paths.falsifier: sold as antivirus or defense sensor; or runtime invented
paths.channel: R&D labs via OFFER after P01; no contractor BD this run

paths.painful_job: Need an error-only predictive stack they can cite as gates, not a PyTorch sketch.
paths.why_subzero: PRED: 3x128, error-only transmit, 17664 gates, depth 42, self-clock error-out=next prediction-in. Structural only.
paths.offer: feasibility packet + optional later walk: layer-by-layer construction vs predictive-coding literature. No weights transferred.
acceptance: NOT-WALKED unless a later paid walk is added
paths.proof_missing: any next-tick prediction bits from a walk
paths.falsifier: claims biological predictive coding is implemented; or walks silently

paths.painful_job: Need a hashable analog of flow, pheromone, and avalanche without a black-box simulator license.
paths.why_subzero: FLOW 23040-gate 16x16 conductance; STIG 15360-gate 3-bit pheromone; SOCR 15872-gate topple-at-4. All self-clocked. Industrial demand is hypothesized from Siemens verification pain, not from a signed SOW.
paths.offer: feasibility packet comparing the three nets to customer-named process diagrams. Later paid walk optional.
inputs: customer public P&ID sketch or refuse
paths.proof_missing: any settle of conductance/pheromone/height; any plant data
paths.falsifier: sold as a DCS/PLC replacement or safety-rated controller
paths.channel: industrial R&D via OFFER; no plant-floor install

paths.painful_job: Need a Petri-style chemical net as gates so they can compare against their token simulator.
paths.why_subzero: PETR: 64 four-bit places, 32 transitions, 2A+B->2B, 3552 gates, marking-out=marking-in, no host sequence.
paths.offer: comparison packet: one transition enable/consume/produce count vs a customer-named Petri tool. Not a process license.
acceptance: one transition arithmetic reproduced on paper
paths.proof_missing: marking-vector after a settle; vendor tool license

paths.painful_job: Need associative recall and hypervector bind/bundle as countable gates for a paper or edge prototype.
paths.why_subzero: HOPF 37248-gate 64-neuron sign weights; HDVS 12288-gate 1024-bit bind/bundle/permute. Both structural.
paths.offer: paired feasibility packet. Optional later recall walk. Not a memory-product license.
paths.proof_missing: any recalled pattern or similarity bit from a walk
paths.falsifier: claims Hopfield capacity theorems are empirically met

paths.painful_job: Need a 256-spin 4-neighbour anneal they can count, before buying annealer hype.
paths.why_subzero: ISPN: 8784 gates, 16-bit decrementer as temperature, self-clocked spins. Not a quantum annealer and not claimed as one.
paths.offer: feasibility packet + optional later energy-trace walk.
paths.proof_missing: any spin configuration after N settles
paths.falsifier: marketed as quantum or as a drop-in Ising solver

paths.painful_job: Need SAT-like voting and a pushdown parser as gates to test whether their formal tools can ingest an alien netlist.
paths.why_subzero: TSET 23856-gate 32x32 clauses, vote bit. PDAP 2656-gate unrolled PDA, depth 192. Siemens 2024 IC/ASIC: first-silicon success 14%. Talent-gap is their stated pain.
paths.offer: ingest challenge: customer runs their formal/sim tool on a translated netlist; we supply the SHA-pinned source and a translation note.
acceptance: no claim their tool passed unless the log says so
paths.falsifier: we invent a green formal proof
paths.channel: verification academy / vendor research; no outreach now

paths.painful_job: Need a closed, non-confidential-then-NDA briefing on a novel substrate without buying a $30k GGUF pilot.
paths.why_subzero: Additive to White Box. Portfolio already ranked paid briefings but reserved founder slot for White Box NOW. This briefing is SUBZERO-only and materials-first.
paths.offer: 90-minute recorded briefing + packet. Hide-list stays hidden. No GGUF ablation.
paths.gross_margin_hypothesis: 0.80-0.90 if recorded; founder live is HIGH collision
paths.proof_missing: any vendor who asked; any NDA
paths.falsifier: briefing dumps hide-list; or double-books a live White Box pilot
paths.channel: OFFER after P01/P03 exist as files

paths.painful_job: Need composed organs (chimeras) as evidence that wiring addresses is the composition method, not a new model train.
paths.why_subzero: Public chimeras 20-28 plus census chimeras in titan (owner-PC, not remeasured here). alife loop MHA→EAL→HPC→VSCF is registry text. NIST autonomous-systems page exists; no readiness claim.
paths.offer: composition packet: dest-FROM-FILE maps for two public chimeras. No titan write. No device actuation.
acceptance: dest maps cited from existing cards
paths.proof_missing: any chimera walk; any self-heal metric
paths.falsifier: claims a self-healing product or DARPA-ready system

paths.painful_job: Need an unclassified literature-and-artifact packet they can put in a B&P folder without a readiness stamp.
paths.why_subzero: BYZQ is a 14880-gate 31-node 3-phase quorum structure. That is a netlist analog, not PBFT in production, not CMMC, not ITAR, not certified.
paths.offer: unclassified literature packet + BYZQ construction. Explicit banner: NOT defense-ready, NOT CUI, NOT a weapon system.
acceptance: no outreach to contracting officers this run
inputs: public papers the buyer already holds
paths.proof_missing: any contractor RFI; any facility clearance discussion is out of scope
paths.falsifier: any regulated/defense readiness claim; any CUI handling
paths.channel: inbound OFFER only; this run does not message buyers
